# Vendored game engines

The arcade serves the official minified browser builds locally. The files are byte-for-byte copies of the versioned npm distributions linked in the upstream releases.

| Engine | Release | Local bundle | Download | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Phaser | [4.2.1](https://phaser.io/download/release/v4.2.1) | [phaser.min.js](../phaser.min.js) | [npm distribution](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js) | [MIT](Phaser-LICENSE.md), [upstream](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@4.2.1/LICENSE.md) |
| PixiJS | [8.23.0](https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs/releases/tag/v8.23.0) | [pixi.min.js](../pixi.min.js) | [npm distribution](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@8.23.0/dist/pixi.min.js) | [MIT](PixiJS-LICENSE.txt), [upstream](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixi.js@8.23.0/LICENSE) |
